description:
Read a file. Text output uses 1-based physical line numbers followed by a tab; remove this display prefix before editing. Use offset/limit for bounded reads (default 2000 lines). Knowledge frontmatter and blank lines count as physical lines; registered external knowledge paths are readable.

Set outline=true for a C# (.cs) or Markdown (.md) structural outline instead of original file content. It ignores offset/limit; unsupported file types return an error.
{image_read_guidance}Use list for directories.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from for text files (1-indexed){image_offset_behavior}

limit.description: Max number of lines to read for text files (default 2000){image_offset_behavior}

outline.description: Return an outline instead of original content; supported only for C# (.cs) and Markdown (.md)
